constraints.constraint: NO MAGIC NUMBERS: All numeric constants MUST come from config_*.h headers. Zero tolerance.
SI UNITS: All positions in meters/radians, velocities in m/s or rad/s.
TIMING: Events must be published within 10ms of condition occurring (TIMING_CMD_RESPONSE_MS).
THREAD SAFETY: Motor callbacks may fire from ISR context - use event_publish_from_isr() when appropriate.
DUAL-CORE: Event processing runs on Core 0, motion control on Core 1. Event queue decouples them.
POSITION TRACKING: Position is a Promise - updated at queue time, not ISR time.
TWO-PHASE COMPLETION: Motion complete fires from onTransmitDone(), not encodeCallback().
WERROR: All code must compile without warnings (-Werror enabled).

previousStoryLearnings.learning: Position is updated at queue time (pushCommand), not ISR time. position_tracker_ reflects where motor WILL BE after queued commands. pulse_count_ stays cumulative for stopImmediate() sync.

Phase 1: Queue empty, set rmt_stopped_, fill final pause. Phase 2: Next callback sees rmt_stopped_, return done=true. Phase 3: onTransmitDone callback fires, motion truly complete. Completion callback fires from onTransmitDone(), not encodeCallback().
target_pos always positive. queue_end_.position positive for FWD, negative for REV. FWD: remaining = target_pos - queue_end_.position REV: remaining = target_pos + queue_end_.position
stop_handler.cpp for STOP command, velocity_handler.cpp for VEL, enable_handler.cpp for EN, position_handler.cpp for POS.
